svg.title: Kleidos: hardware password manager. Your passwords, on a board you already own.
svg.desc: Nine boards on one shelf at one scale, each showing its real Kleidos screen, first the locked PIN screen and then the password list: M5StickS3, M5StickC Plus2, M5StickC Plus 1.1, M5StickC Plus SE, M5Stack CoreInk, M5Stack CoreS3 SE, M5Stack Core2 v1.3, M5Cardputer ADV and LilyGO T-Deck Plus.
